mapper.select: SELECT PARAM_VALUE FROM SYS_PARA WHERE PARA_CODE = #{paraCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT DISTINCT INSTITUTION_CODE as institutionCode, DEPT_CODE as deptCode FROM SYS_DATA_ROLE_MODULE WHERE ROLE_ID IN (SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SYS_USER_ROLE WHERE USER_ID = #{username, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND ROLE_DATA_TYPE IN ('01')

SELECT DISTINCT A.INSTITUTION_CODE FROM SYS_INSTITUTION A START WITH A.INSTITUTION_CODE = #{deptCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} CONNECT BY A.UPPER_INSTITUTION_CODE = PRIOR A.INSTITUTION_CODE UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT B.DEPT_CODE FROM SYS_DEPARTMENT B START WITH B.DEPT_CODE = #{deptCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} CONNECT BY B.UPPER_DEPT_CODE = PRIOR B.DEPT_CODE
